2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.763 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406, 504 IPC, registered at Police Station Kotwali Nagar,
District Faizabad /Ayodhya.

sentences.text:
3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 27.11.2022 against four persons, including the applicant, for commission of offences under Sections 420, 406, 504 I.P.C.,
alleging that the informant had made investments in Maa Media House under the impression of getting lucrative return but no return was paid to him and the role of the applicant is MD and Operator of the said firm.

4. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 22.09.2021, he has already spent about four years in custody whereas the allegation of offences carries a maximum punishment up to 7 years but even charges have not been framed by the trial court till date.
5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application but he could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

7. A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant disclosing his involvement in 22 criminal cases, which are similar in nature, and the applicant has been ordered to be released on bail in 18 of those cases.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact as the applicant has already spent more than half of the sentence that could be awarded to him under the said offences, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant Rahul Mishra be released on bail in the aforementioned case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
